name: working-backwards
description: A customer-first Working Backwards workflow for turning ambiguous product ideas into decision-ready PR/FAQs and evidence plans.

interface.shortDescription: Turn product ambiguity into testable PR/FAQs.
interface.longDescription: Work from a specific customer outcome to a future promise, hard FAQs, evidence ledger, staged experiment, and owned decision.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Working Backwards to turn this product idea into a customer-first promise, hard FAQs, evidence plan, and owned next decision.
